For an **AI-powered digital marketing agency**, I would avoid presenting the portal as a long list of generic services. Build it as a **customer acquisition + sales portal** where prospects can understand the outcome, see proof, get an estimate, and start a project.

### Services I would showcase

| Service area | What customer sees | AI capability behind it | Business outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| **AI Marketing Strategy** | Marketing audit, competitor analysis, growth plan | Research/strategy agents | Clear growth roadmap |
| **SEO + AI Search Optimization** | SEO, local SEO, GEO/AEO, AI-search visibility | Keyword/content/competitor agents | Organic leads |
| **Content Marketing** | Blogs, landing pages, newsletters, case studies | GenAI content workflow | Traffic + authority |
| **Social Media** | LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X content | Content + scheduling agents | Engagement + leads |
| **Paid Advertising** | Google/Meta/LinkedIn campaigns | Creative + optimization agents | Lower CAC / higher ROAS |
| **AI Ad Creative** | Images, video ads, UGC-style creatives | Generative image/video | Faster campaign production |
| **Website & Landing Pages** | Website, campaign pages, lead funnels | AI-assisted web generation | Better conversion |
| **AI Chatbot / Sales Agent** | 24×7 website assistant | RAG + agentic AI | Capture/qualify leads |
| **AI Voice Agent** | Inbound/outbound calling | Voice AI + CRM integration | Appointments/sales |
| **Lead Generation** | Prospect discovery + enrichment | Research/enrichment agents | More qualified leads |
| **Email Marketing** | Campaigns, nurture sequences | Personalization agents | Lead conversion |
| **Marketing Automation** | Automated follow-up/workflows | Agents + workflow automation | Less manual work |
| **CRM & Sales Automation** | Pipeline, scoring, reminders | AI lead scoring | Faster sales cycle |
| **Reputation Management** | Reviews, sentiment, responses | Sentiment/response AI | Stronger reputation |
| **Analytics & Attribution** | Executive dashboards | AI analytics | ROI visibility |
| **E-commerce Marketing** | Recommendations, abandoned carts, campaigns | Personalization AI | Revenue growth |
| **Local Business Growth** | Google profile/local campaigns | Local marketing automation | Calls/appointments |
| **Multilingual Marketing** | Localized ads/content | LLM translation/localization | New markets |

But the **sales portal itself** is where you can differentiate.

## Customer Sales Portal

Think of this journey:

**Visitor → AI consultation → marketing audit → recommendation → package → proposal → payment → onboarding → campaign → analytics → upsell**

Your portal home page could lead with:

> **Grow Your Business With an AI-Powered Marketing Team**  
> Strategy, content, advertising, SEO, lead generation and sales automation—connected through AI.

Then provide 4 prominent actions:

**Get Free AI Audit** | **Build My Marketing Plan** | **Get Pricing** | **Talk to AI Marketing Consultant**

### 1. AI Marketing Audit

Customer enters:

Company website  
Industry  
Location/market  
B2B/B2C  
Monthly marketing budget  
Revenue range  
Current channels  
Main competitors  
Primary objective

Your system analyzes:

```text
Website
   ↓
SEO + Content + Social + Ads + Competitors
   ↓
AI Marketing Audit
   ↓
Marketing Score: 62/100
   ↓
Top opportunities
   ↓
Recommended services
   ↓
Estimated ROI / KPI targets
   ↓
Book consultation
```

This becomes a powerful **lead magnet**.

### 2. AI Strategy Builder

Instead of asking prospects to understand 20 services, let AI recommend them.

For example:

> **Business:** Calgary dental clinic  
> **Goal:** +40 appointments/month  
> **Recommended:** Local SEO + Google Ads + Review Automation + AI Receptionist + Lead Follow-up  
> **Suggested engagement:** Growth Package

Now you are selling an **outcome**, rather than individual technologies.

### 3. Packages

I would create roughly four commercial tiers:

| Starter | Growth | AI Scale | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|
| Local SEO | SEO/GEO | Everything in Growth | Custom strategy |
| Social content | Content engine | AI sales agent | Multi-brand |
| Basic analytics | Paid campaigns | Voice/chat agents | CRM integration |
| Monthly report | Lead generation | Advanced automation | Custom AI agents |
| Small businesses | Growing companies | AI-first companies | Larger organizations |

Don't hard-code prices initially if you're still testing the business. Use **"Starting from"** or **"Get Custom Quote."**

### 4. Customer Dashboard

Once someone becomes a customer, the same portal should turn into their operating dashboard.

```text
CUSTOMER DASHBOARD

Marketing Health Score        81 ↑

Leads             287
Qualified Leads   94
Appointments      38
Conversions       21
Revenue        $42,800
Ad Spend        $8,200
ROAS              5.2x
CAC                $390

SEO      ↑ 18%
Social   ↑ 24%
Ads      ↑ 31%
Email    ↑ 12%

AI Recommendations
────────────────────────────
⚡ Increase Campaign A budget
⚡ Landing page B has low conversion
⚡ 17 leads require follow-up
⚡ Competitor X launched new campaign
```

That dashboard itself becomes part of your product differentiation.

### 5. Put AI Agents inside the portal

This is where your agency can look substantially different from a conventional marketing company.

**Marketing Manager Agent**  
coordinates campaigns.

**SEO/GEO Agent**  
monitors keywords, competitors and AI-search visibility.

**Content Agent**  
generates campaign ideas and drafts.

**Creative Agent**  
produces image/video concepts.

**Ads Agent**  
analyzes campaigns and recommends budget changes.

**Lead Agent**  
qualifies incoming prospects.

**Sales Agent**  
handles follow-ups.

**Voice Agent**  
calls or answers prospects.

**Analytics Agent**  
explains what is happening.

**Customer Success Agent**  
answers client questions using their campaign information.

They should not all autonomously publish/spend money. Use approvals for consequential actions:

**AI recommends → human/client approves → system executes → result measured.**

### 6. Your strongest differentiation

Given the technical direction you're pursuing, I wouldn't position this simply as:

**"Digital Marketing Agency Using AI."**

There are already many companies saying that.

A stronger positioning would be:

> **AI Growth & Revenue Automation Platform + Managed Marketing Services**

That gives you three things to sell:

**Services** — SEO, ads, social, content, campaigns.

**Automation** — agents, CRM, voice AI, lead nurturing.

**Platform** — customer dashboard, analytics, attribution, approvals and AI recommendations.

Eventually this gives you a path from an **agency business → managed AI service → SaaS platform**.

### Portal architecture I would build

```text
                    AI GROWTH PORTAL
                           │
        ┌──────────────────┼──────────────────┐
        │                  │                  │
   ACQUISITION          SALES              CLIENT
      PORTAL            PORTAL             PORTAL
        │                  │                  │
   Free AI Audit       Lead CRM          Dashboard
   SEO Audit           Pipeline          Campaigns
   Competitors         AI Scoring        Analytics
   Strategy            Proposal          Approvals
   ROI Calculator      Contract          Reports
        │              Payment              │
        └──────────────────┬──────────────────┘
                           │
                     AI AGENT LAYER
                           │
     ┌─────────┬───────────┼───────────┬─────────┐
    SEO      Content      Ads        Sales     Analytics
   Agent      Agent      Agent       Agent       Agent
                           │
                    AUTOMATION LAYER
                           │
       CRM • Email • Social • Ads • Voice • Web
                           │
                    DATA / GOVERNANCE
```

The **first MVP should not try to implement everything**. I would showcase about **8–10 services**, but make only five workflows exceptionally strong: **AI Marketing Audit → Strategy/Quote → Lead CRM → AI Sales Follow-up → Customer ROI Dashboard**.

That combination demonstrates both a real digital marketing agency and the AI architecture behind it—which is much more compelling than another agency website with a chatbot.

**Document Processing Agent**

Email/PDF → extraction → classification → validation → business system → approval.

### RAG services should also be broken down

Don't simply write **"We Build RAG."** Customers generally don't buy RAG—they buy solutions to knowledge problems.

Present:

**Enterprise Knowledge Assistant**  
Ask questions across company documents.

**SharePoint / Google Drive Knowledge AI**  
Connect existing enterprise repositories.

**Customer Support RAG**  
Ground support answers in manuals, policies and tickets.

**Sales Knowledge Assistant**  
Products + pricing + proposals + case studies.

**Multimodal RAG**  
PDF + image + audio + video + tables.

**GraphRAG**  
Relationship-heavy knowledge and complex research.

**Secure RAG**  
RBAC/ABAC, SSO, document-level authorization.

**RAG Modernization**  
Improve an existing RAG system suffering from hallucination, poor retrieval, latency or cost.

And importantly:

**RAG Evaluation & Optimization**

```text
Retrieval Quality
Faithfulness
Groundedness
Answer Relevance
Context Precision
Context Recall
Hallucination
Latency
Token Consumption
Cost / Query
```

That last service can be particularly useful because many organizations already have RAG prototypes but struggle to make them production-ready.

### Your portal navigation could therefore be

**Solutions | Agentic AI | Enterprise RAG | AI Marketing | AI Sales | Voice AI | Automation | AI Platform | Governance | Case Studies | Pricing | Free AI Assessment**

Under **Agentic AI**, show: Multi-Agent Systems, MCP Integration, AI Workflow Automation, Sales Agents, Marketing Agents, Customer-Service Agents and Research Agents.

Under **Enterprise RAG**, show: Knowledge RAG, GraphRAG, Multimodal RAG, Secure RAG, RAG Evaluation and RAG Modernization.

This positioning lets you operate as a **digital marketing agency + AI engineering/automation company**, rather than competing only with traditional SEO/social-media agencies.

### What the customer receives

Don't stop at a PDF. Give them a **Market Intelligence Dashboard** containing market overview, competitor matrix, customer segments, pricing comparison, trends, SWOT, opportunity score, risks, recommended actions and source/evidence links.

Then add an **“Ask Your Research”** RAG interface. For example, after buying a competitor study, the customer could ask:

> “Which three competitors are strongest in Canada?”  
> “Compare their pricing.”  
> “What customer complaints occur most frequently?”  
> “Where is the biggest product gap?”  
> “What should our positioning be?”

That makes your research **continuously usable**, rather than a static report.

### Recurring intelligence can become a subscription

This is particularly attractive commercially.

**One-time research** → Market assessment  
**Monthly** → Competitor intelligence  
**Weekly** → Market/industry monitoring  
**Continuous** → AI intelligence agents

For example:

> **Competitor Intelligence as a Service**  
> AI agents continuously track competitor websites, products, pricing, campaigns, hiring, announcements and market signals, then surface meaningful changes.

This gives your agency recurring revenue rather than relying entirely on one-off marketing projects.

Your eventual top-level offering could therefore be:

**Digital Marketing | AI Market Intelligence | Agentic AI | Enterprise RAG | AI Sales & Voice | AI Automation | AI Governance**

That is a much stronger portfolio because **Market Intelligence discovers the opportunity → Digital Marketing creates demand → AI Sales converts it → Agentic AI automates it → RAG supplies trusted knowledge → Analytics measures the result.**

That **end-to-end AI growth engine** should be the central story of the portal, rather than presenting dozens of disconnected AI services.
